label: Dance
description: Musical, syncopated: waltz 3/4, swing, drum fills, breakbeats.

patterns.name: Waltz Classic
patterns.description: Elegant 3/4 waltz: gentle lifts build to a sweeping peak, a hushed breakdown, then a return.

patterns.name: Slow Waltz
patterns.description: Stately waltz with long, flowing movements and soft accents.

patterns.name: Viennese Waltz
patterns.description: Fast whirling waltz: rotation sweeps ahead, a spin breakdown, then a rushing finish.

patterns.name: Swing Shuffle
patterns.description: Swung triplet shuffle: the two motors trade the lead, with a stop-time breath before the turnaround.

patterns.name: Lindy Swing
patterns.description: Energetic lindy: strong beats, a stop-time break, a rising run and a playful tag.

patterns.name: Slow Swing
patterns.description: Lazy swing with long sweeping sways that swell, ease off and settle back.

patterns.name: Breakbeat Basic
patterns.description: Syncopated breakbeat: groove, a fill, a half-time breakdown and a driving return.

patterns.name: Amen Break
patterns.description: The Amen break: fast and funky, with a ghost-note variation, a drop and a rolling fill.

patterns.name: Halftime Break
patterns.description: Breakbeat at half speed with heavy, syncopated hits.

patterns.name: Drum Roll
patterns.description: Drum roll built in waves: each roll climbs higher, ending in a crash and a long decay.

patterns.name: Tom Fill
patterns.description: Tom-tom style fill with rotating accents.

patterns.name: Snare Roll
patterns.description: Snare fills: sparse hits tighten into a roll, crash, then a shorter answer fill.

patterns.name: Passionate Tango
patterns.description: Sharp, staccato movements with dramatic pauses.

patterns.name: Staccato Tango
patterns.description: Quick, sharp bursts with sudden stops.

patterns.name: Cha-Cha
patterns.description: Lively cha-cha: slow, slow, cha-cha-cha, with the motors trading the lead before a soft break.

patterns.name: Samba
patterns.description: Bouncy samba rhythm with rapid oscillation.

patterns.name: Rumba
patterns.description: Slow, sensual rumba with deep, rolling movements.

patterns.name: Foxtrot
patterns.description: Smooth, flowing foxtrot with gentle thrusts.

patterns.name: Jive
patterns.description: Upbeat jive: bouncy, rapid kicks, a breather, then a climbing run to a bright finish.

patterns.name: Mambo
patterns.description: Hot syncopated mambo: sharp accents, a quick montuno break and a full-blooded cierre.

patterns.name: Paso Doble
patterns.description: Dramatic paso doble with strong, proud beats.

patterns.name: Quickstep
patterns.description: Fast, light quickstep with rapid footwork.

patterns.name: Disco Fever
patterns.description: Funky disco beat with rotating lights vibe.

patterns.name: Arabesque
patterns.description: Graceful ballet arabesque with slow, controlled movements.
